==Notes==
*Upon usage, Revitalizers reset the recast timers on all job abilities, including [[:Category:SP Ability|SP Abilities]].
*Revitalizers can be acquired in several locations:
** [[Abyssea]]: Randomly from maximum level amber crates. Granted to the entire alliance when defeating [[Resheph]] or [[Cuijatender]] ({{Gdrop}}).
** [[Moblin Maze Mongers]]: Obtained by the entire party when the leader spends 3 C.C. points to acquire medicines from [[Sadistiq]] in a MMM Revitalization Team maze.
***See the following page for how to access revitalizers without obtaining Maze Voucher 09 yourself [https://www.bg-wiki.com/ffxi/Category:Moblin_Maze_Mongers#Step-by-step_guide_to_getting_Revitalizer_and_resetting_SPs]
** [[Besieged]]: Obtained automatically.
** [[Nyzul Isle]], [[Salvage]]: Obtained randomly from armoury crates.
** [[Voidwatch]]: Obtained upon hitting an extreme vulnerability with a [[periapt of recompense]] in possession.
